tools.name: view_part
tools.description: Get a picture of a part from one side, with its measured size and features. Use it to check that the part is what the user asked for before you price or order it.

tools.name: price_part
tools.description: Get the price to CNC machine a part in the US. KinetiCAD's engine plans how the part is machined (the machine, the setups, the tools and the cycle time), and the price is the setup time and the machine time at a US shop rate, plus the material. Returns the unit price for the quantity, the cost lines
